global.requirement: A clearly dimensional, stylized 3D/cartoon educational illustration with realistic materials, rather than a flat vector diagram.
No embedded writing, labels, numerals, logos or visible brand names. Blank label areas are allowed.
The relevant objects are identifiable and not cropped off; geometry and construction are plausible for simplified educational art.

soil-core.requirement: Shows a soil block with crop plants and a functional T-handle sampling probe holding soil; the cutaway makes vertical sampling understandable.

sampling-kit.requirement: The steel probe and its open sampling tube are visibly empty and clean; the plastic bucket is empty and clean.
Shows a bucket, manual sampling probe, sample pouch, marker and gloves as distinguishable objects.

field-zone.requirement: Normal crop rows show one visually consistent crop type; only the wet patch and old manure patch are anomalous.
Both a waterlogged area and a separate manure-like patch can be identified.

mixing.requirement: Shows soil in a bucket with a scoop, and a sample pouch nearby; no impossible suspended stream or disconnected tool.

sample-record.requirement: Shows a sample pouch with a usable blank label, a clipboard with blank paper, and a marker.
